notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other nontoken artifact creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When the artifact creature enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers, creating a 2/2 Human Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Knight, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
